name: mf
title: Mutual Funds

Coin.screen: Coin app home (stands in for Kite)

offline_items: Cold launch in airplane mode → Explore > MF tab shows cached data
Cached data shows a 'last updated' time or stale indicator
Network lost while on Explore > MF tab → data stays visible (no blank screen or crash)
Clear offline message or banner shown
Auto-refresh on reconnect (no manual pull needed)
No forced re-login or PIN after reconnect
fund detail opens offline from cache
Cached values are clearly not presented as live prices
No crash or ANR during offline ↔ online transitions
notes: READ-ONLY: accounts belong to other people. Browse only: open the MF screen, scroll the list, open and close a fund. Never tap Invest, Start SIP, Lumpsum, Redeem, Withdraw, Add money, Mandate/Autopay or Cart. Data items such as 'SIP entry point' are checked by sight, never tapped. open_tap for the leak check must land on a fund card or Back.
